rules.explanation: Detekt found this issue and decides itself whether it fails the build. The gate shows it so that one report holds everything.

rules.summary: Line coverage is below the minimum
rules.explanation: The tests cover fewer lines than coverage { verify { minLineCoverage } } asks for. Kover's verification decides whether that fails the build.

rules.summary: The API dump no longer matches the code
rules.explanation: The public binary interface changed without a new dump. kreateApiCheck fails on it; run kreateApiDump if the change is intended.
